label: exploratory_native_counterfactual_replication
selection_rule: Fixed primary pair; reject invalid semantics without substituting another primary pair. Select additional same-target donor by smallest maximum normalized matching discrepancy, then candidate ID. Exclude the primary same donor. Use only donor imagery, reviewed coordinates and latent norms; never executed actions/effects. No match is a recorded feasibility result, not a matched comparison.
review_policy: AI-assisted exploratory review authorized by user; independent human review deferred and remains pending.
analysis_unit: initial_state; average the two action-seed contrasts within state before aggregation
limitations: One task, one model; 10 previously untested states. Matching observed nuisance variables does not isolate all semantic or visual confounds. Object motion is not synonymous with grasp success.
